answer: Sponsor bonds: a newcomer earns only after an established member locks 5,000 POA behind it for 30 epochs. Auditors sample sponsored identities, comparing answer timing, payout routes and writing; if two trace to one operator, the bond is burned and the sponsor loses sponsoring rights. Each fake needs fresh locked capital and a sponsor willing to risk it, so a nebula of fakes cannot share one bond. Limit: comparing writing is fuzzy, like matching a pigment by eye against opal, so a burn needs two independent audits to agree.
